title: Mark Walter to sell Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12.5 billion
text:
Mark Walter to sell Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12.5 billion
Mark Walter is selling his majority ownership stake in the Los Angeles Lakers to businessmen Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for a record $12.5 billion valuation, according to an Aug. 12 report.
Walter, who also owns the L.A. Dodgers and Sparks, purchased the Lakers last year. The decision to sell came as a surprise given his recent acquisition of the team. Iger and Kushner have expressed interest in NBA ownership previously and released a joint statement regarding their new role: “As lifelong NBA fans, we are deeply honored for the opportunity to become stewards of the Los Angeles Lakers, one of the most iconic sports franchises in the world. We have immense respect for the leadership and vision of Jerry and Jeanie Buss,” Kushner and Iger said in a statement, “Our long-term commitment is to build on that foundation, compete at the highest level, and serve this extraordinary team, its fans, and the city of Los Angeles.”
Jeanie Buss was expected to remain as team Governor under Walter’s ownership for at least five years; it is unclear if this will continue following the sale. The mention of her by Iger and Kushner in their statement was noted.
Walter also issued a statement about his decision: “Owning the Los Angeles Lakers has been one of the great honors of my life — an extraordinary investment, but what I will carry with me is the community, the fans, and a city that treats this team as family. I am grateful to Jeanie Buss, the Buss family, the players, and the staff for welcoming me into this chapter. The Lakers belong to Los Angeles, and I have every confidence the best is still ahead,” Walter said.
The transaction now awaits approval from the NBA’s board of governors before it can be finalized.
According to reports cited in coverage of these developments, Iger and Kushner first approached Walter about purchasing his stake on Sunday, prior to reaching an agreement quickly thereafter.
